title: Trust a changed host key
description: A touch panel was reimaged, so it presents a new ssh host key and the node refused it. Read both keys, learn why a key changes, trust the new one, and watch the session come up.

steps.caption: This place's system. A node collects its touch panel over the panel's ssh console.
Expand it to the component's view, where collection is read.
The host key changed, so the node refused before logging in. It names the key pinned and the key offered.
Trusting a key decides who the node will talk to, so it confirms first.
The confirm shows both keys again, and why a key changes.
Each cause teaches itself on hover or focus.
A reinstall or a swap is safe to trust. A change nobody can explain may be something answering in its place.
This panel was reimaged, so trust it. The offered key becomes the pin; the audit log records both keys and who.
The node redials onto the new pin at its next check-in, and the session reads up.
